title: Make a night of dinner at the Inn at Little Washington
description: Travel to the small Virginia town of Washington for a dinner that unfolds over several courses at the Inn at Little Washington. The dining room treats food, service, and setting as parts of one carefully paced evening. Arrive without a rush, notice the details between courses, and let the trip there become part of the occasion.
teaser: Plan a special dinner in a tiny Virginia town.
goodToKnow: Premium experience. Reserve ahead and confirm dietary needs and access.
whyItMightDelightYou: The distance from ordinary routines makes the meal feel like a destination in its own right.
